execution.initial_environment_check: The Windows Store python alias exited without output; all evidence commands used the project .venv interpreter.

invariants_verified: Every query-scoped semantic and required relation must have an explicit state; omissions fail compilation.
Every decision has a bounded rationale and every present semantic has an exact prompt occurrence.
An unresolved required relation remains unresolved and is not converted to absent.
Schema-2.0 graphs serialize unresolved relations while frozen schema-1.0 records retain their original content identity and canonical field set.
No arm, generated code, Oracle result, Functional Judge result, or experiment outcome was available to contract construction.
protocol_risks: All four prompts and prior representation labels were exposed; this is implementation evidence, not an accuracy estimate.
The contracts were manually authored. No LLM proposer or independent reviewer workflow has yet been implemented or qualified for this schema.
The bearer-token case follows the frozen v4 interpretation; the application-credential versus per-request-token construct boundary still requires prospective source-only definition review.
A task evaluated under multiple queries may receive duplicated query-scoped decisions; cross-query consistency must be checked before activation without creating a second semantic authority.
disposition: The architecture canary supports replacing direct LLM graph authorship with exhaustive reviewed task-context contracts and deterministic graph compilation. It does not repair, rerun, or reopen Gate C. The next admissible evidence is a prospectively frozen independent qualification of contract production.
